deploy-bot: START: initiating image build + registry push for service/edge-proxy tag=v0.13.2-20260320 commit=a1b2c3d env=prod change_window=2026-03-21T02:00Z-03:00Z
jess_k: watching. rolling canary planned after push :eyes:
ci-bot: build completed: success
ci-bot: image sha256:0f4e9b pushed to registry.redwood.cloud/infra/edge-proxy:v0.13.2-20260320 (layers uploaded)
deploy-bot: starting manifest upload -> registry.redwood.cloud/infra/edge-proxy:v0.13.2-20260320
deploy-bot: ERROR: manifest upload returned 504 Gateway Timeout (attempt 1/5) :warning:
ryan_p: are retries automated? what's the retry backoff?
deploy-bot: yes, auto-retry up to 5 with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s)
deploy-bot: retry attempt 2 -> 504 again
anita-oncall: if prod push keeps failing we should pin prod to previous image and stop the rollout. we don't want partial prod traffic to see mixed images
darren_m: agreed. can we still finish staging and run canary there?
ci-bot: staging push succeeded earlier (same image). staging tag: registry.redwood.cloud/infra/edge-proxy:canary-20260320
ryan_p: quick check - is this the registry infra or our egress/proxy timing out? logs?
deploy-bot: uploading registry server response logs -> s3://redwood-ci/logs/1779902400/manifest-upload.log
opsbot: Incident note created: INF-2026-042, title='Registry manifest upload 504 during prod push', severity=low, owner=@ryan_p
jess_k: decision: abort prod push, pin prod to previous image (v0.13.1 sha=7a2d9c4). open a rollback/pin ticket and disable automatic retries for this thread.
ryan_p: I'll pin prod now via the platform API and update the routing table. command: `redwoodctl release pin --service edge-proxy --image registry.redwood.cloud/infra/edge-proxy:v0.13.1 --reason "manifest 504 on prod push 1779902400"`
ryan_p: done. prod pinned to v0.13.1 sha=7a2d9c4 :white_check_mark:
jess_k: good. we'll keep canary in staging running and run manual push later during the maintenance window with extra logging and `skopeo` multi-part upload.
anita-oncall: add playbook step: if manifest upload 504 -> try `skopeo copy` with --retry-times 5, collect `journalctl -u registry` and increase HTTP client timeout to 60s. example:
```
skopeo copy --retry-times 5 docker-daemon:edge-proxy:local docker://registry.redwood.cloud/infra/edge-proxy:v0.13.2-20260320 --dest-tls-verify=false
```
ci-bot: attached build artifacts and full log: https://ci.redwood.cloud/builds/1779902400/artifacts.tar.gz
darren_m: note for release notes: feature set for 0.13.2 is ready; prod rollout delayed due to registry upload. we should call out pinned version in notes and schedule follow-up deploy.
jess_k: created release ticket REL-392, linked INF-2026-042, assigned to @ryan_p for follow-up. scheduled retry in change window 2026-03-21T02:00Z.
opsbot: Reminders: - If manual push needed, coordinate with SRE on egress/backoff - Keep stakeholders updated in #product-release :bell:
ryan_p: follow-up plan: debug registry egress from build runners, try `skopeo` push from runner in the maintenance window, collect tcpdump if it times out.
jess_k: thanks everyone. thread closed for prod push. we'll reopen if manual push started. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: STATUS: PROD_PUSH_ABORTED, STAGING_CANARY_ACTIVE, PROD_PINNED=v0.13.1
